import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Top: Revenue by product category (bar chart)
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = ax1.bar(product_revenue.index, product_revenue.values)
ax1.set_title('Total Revenue by Product', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + max(product_revenue.values)*0.01,
             f'${height:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 2. Middle-left: Sales distribution by time of day (heatmap)
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
df['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(df['time']).dt.hour
time_sales = df.groupby(['hour', 'product'])['quantity'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
sns.heatmap(time_sales, cmap='YlOrRd', ax=ax2, cbar_kws={'label': 'Quantity Sold'})
ax2.set_title('Sales Heatmap: Time of Day vs Product', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=12)

# 3. Middle-center: Revenue by age group and takeaway status (grouped bar)
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
age_takeaway = df.groupby(['customer_age_group', 'is_takeaway'])['total'].sum().unstack()
age_takeaway.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3)
ax3.set_title('Revenue by Age Group & Takeaway Status', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12)
ax3.legend(['Dine-in', 'Takeaway'], title='Service Type')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# 4. Middle-right: Payment method distribution (pie chart)
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
payment_dist = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(payment_dist.values, labels=payment_dist.index, 
                                   autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90)
ax4.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 5. Bottom-left: Price distribution by size (box plot)
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='size', y='price', order=['Small', 'Medium', 'Large'], ax=ax5)
ax5.set_title('Price Distribution by Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=12)
ax5.set_ylabel('Price ($)', fontsize=12)

# 6. Bottom-right: Quantity vs Total revenue scatter by product
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
scatter = ax6.scatter(df['quantity'], df['total'], c=pd.Categorical(df['product']).codes, 
                      cmap='tab20', alpha=0.6, s=50)
ax6.set_title('Quantity vs Total Revenue by Product', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Quantity', fontsize=12)
ax6.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12)

# Create custom legend for scatter plot
products = df['product'].unique()
handles = [plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor=plt.cm.tab20(i/len(products)), 
                      markersize=8, label=product) for i, product in enumerate(products)]
ax6.legend(handles=handles, title='Products', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
